_comment: Fonte única de 'ação negada → comando do time'. Lida pelo hook fsd-redirect-hook, pelo fsd-watch (authorAsks) e pelo bloco gerado em common/team.md (fsd-redirects --write; --check falha se o bloco estiver velho). Cada entrada: id; label (a coluna da tabela); match (program, words = subcomandos seguidos, cada um uma regex (checkout|switch), argRegex = regex sobre os argumentos, main = só na pasta principal, skipIfAny = argumentos que deixam o comando como está); do (default, ou por agente: texto = comando do time, { say } = só o aviso); n (pr|issue = de onde vem o <n>); why. Sem match = entrada só de documentação (o vigia cuida). Marcadores: <worktree> <n> <title>. authorAsksSkip: agentes que o vigia não vigia por pedido ao autor (o Kevin decide pelo autor).

redirects.label: `git push`
redirects.why: git push is blocked for agents; fsd-pr open pushes the branch, opens or updates the PR, moves the card and notifies the reviewers

redirects.label: `gh pr review`

stuart.say: A review is not your role: wait for the review of the PR (fsd-wait pr <n> approved|changes).

redirects.why: a PR review is posted through the team command, not through gh

redirects.label: `gh api …/pulls/<n>/reviews`

stuart.say: A review is not your role: wait for the review of the PR (fsd-wait pr <n> approved|changes).

redirects.why: a PR review is posted through the team command, not through gh api

redirects.label: `gh pr merge`

default.say: Only Kevin merges, with fsd-merge <n>. Tell Kevin with fsd-notify kevin when the PR is ready.

redirects.why: a merge goes through fsd-merge, which checks the approvals first

redirects.label: `gh api …/pulls/<n>/merge`

default.say: Only Kevin merges, with fsd-merge <n>. Tell Kevin with fsd-notify kevin when the PR is ready.

redirects.why: a merge goes through fsd-merge, which checks the approvals first

redirects.label: `git checkout <ref>` na pasta principal
redirects.why: the main folder never changes branch; each piece of work lives in its own worktree

redirects.label: `git switch <ref>`
redirects.why: agents never switch branch in place (git switch is denied everywhere); each piece of work lives in its own worktree

redirects.label: `gh issue create`
redirects.why: issues are created through fsd-issue, which sets the labels, the type and the board

redirects.label: pedir uma ação ao autor

do.default: fsd-notify kevin "<what you need>" (Kevin: fsd-issue decide)

redirects.why: agents never ask the author for an action; the watcher forwards such a request to Kevin
